recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, sepia-toned portrait of a smiling male musician with long hair sitting cross-legged on a patterned sofa, holding an acoustic guitar. The scene is set in a rustic, dimly lit room with a vintage feel, featuring a prominent typographic overlay at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally with a slight lean to the right.
Guitar neck creates a strong diagonal line across the midsection.
Text anchored to the bottom edge, spanning the full width.
Warm olive and brown tones unify the subject with the background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the central 60% of the frame, seated on a sofa.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face and the high-contrast body of the acoustic guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the guitar neck down to the hands, then drops to the large-scale text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper third of the image is relatively open with a muted wall and window sill.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted olive green and warm sepia browns in the environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown of the guitar and jeans against the light t-shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal-blue used for the secondary word in the main title.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm, vintage tint; medium-to-high contrast in the subject's clothing and guitar.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and one cool accent

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' is constructed of two overlapping 'V' shapes
The 'E' has equal length horizontal bars

composition.position: Top left inside a translucent box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between a hairline geometric sans and a heavy, industrial slab serif.
graphicDevices: Subtle horizontal rule lines within the label

preserve: Two-tone color split in the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric purity and extreme thinness.
Provides the correct geometric 'O' and 'A' shapes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man with shoulder-length brown hair, smiling, sitting cross-legged on a vintage floral patterned sofa, holding a sunburst acoustic guitar. The room has a rustic, warm olive-toned wall and a window sill with bottles. The overall image has a warm, sepia-tinted film grain look.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, hairline-thin geometric uppercase text across the bottom. The first half of the text should be white, the second half teal. Add a small, dark olive rectangular label in the top left with bold, spaced-out slab-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the main text hairline thin?
Is the color palette dominated by warm olive and sepia?
Does the subject appear relaxed and barefoot?
Is the guitar a sunburst acoustic model?

adjustableVariables: Specific teal hue for the text accent
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the musician
Any brand logos on the guitar headstock
postGenerationChecks: Text is perfectly horizontal and aligned to the bottom.
The teal color provides a clear but subtle contrast.
The musician's pose feels natural and candid.
The sofa pattern is visible but not distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic portrait + Sepia wash + Hairline geometric typography + Two-tone text color split.
